important_notes: Opportunity Number: PDS-CAIRO-001-FY25 — Agency: U.S. Mission to Egypt.
Forecasted Opportunity: This is an advance forecast notice. Official application packages and final closing dates will be released upon posting.
Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity PDS-CAIRO-001-FY25.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.

funded_activities.activity: Eligible activities supporting U.S. Embassy Cairo Public Diplomacy Section Annual Program Statement: PDS Cairo invites proposals for programs that strengthen cultural ties and mutual understanding between the United States and Egypt through cultural, economic, educational, and professional programming.
